era: 2019 NFL.com (the 2018-2020 Wildcat site, before the July 2020 redesign): navy header bar with the NFL shield (NFL 100 in 2019), News, Scores, Schedule, Standings, Highlights, NFL 100, NFL Shop and a menu with Game Pass, Stats, Next Gen Stats, Ways to Watch, NFL Network, Photos, NFL Films; a score strip of game tiles with previous/next arrows; grey page with white story modules and More links. Post-2019 NFL+, My Team, Tickets, VIP Experiences, app download, TikTok/Snapchat links and the post-2019 footer columns are hidden; legal and privacy links and the consent dialog stay.
